subject.title: fix: beta releases require manual reruns after plugin publication

question: After the release-owned changelog edit is removed, should the release owner accept this combined forward-port of beta recovery, Signal shutdown, and test-harness fixes as one release-maintenance change?
rationale: The `maintainer` label requires explicit human handling, and the branch combines several release-sensitive runtime and workflow changes that should be accepted together only by the owner of the release process.

options.title: Review and land the narrowed forward-port
options.body: Remove the `CHANGELOG.md` edit, verify the final-head release evidence, and accept the tested automation and Signal fixes together.

options.title: Split the release fixes
options.body: Land the publication and Signal fixes separately if the release owner wants smaller rollback and audit boundaries.

recommendation.title: Review and land the narrowed forward-port
recommendation.body: Remove the `CHANGELOG.md` edit, verify the final-head release evidence, and accept the tested automation and Signal fixes together.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied commit trail connects this contributor to each of the release-forward-port surfaces, though current-main ownership history could not be independently inspected.
